body:
New server/spawn.Registry (data/mob_spawns.json) is the real per-(zone,kind) on/off toggle, layered on existing per-Kind stat-block constructors. Found and fixed a real live bug in the same pass: HillsSpawns()/CavesSpawns() were never called from world init -- zones 1 and 2 have been silently empty since S189. Both zones now populated. 5 new tests, go test ./... clean. Commit d199a89. Live-verified via a real WHM test character teleporting to both zones.

⚓ ☃
title: GFD-MOBSPAWN-001 Phase 2 shipped: spawn toggles + fixed Hills/Caves-never-spawned bug
